question: JKLM is a cyclic quadrilateral in which ∠K is opposite to ∠M. When JK and ML are produced, meet at point Z. JK = 10 cm, KZ = 12 cm and MZ = 33 cm. What is the length of LZ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **cyclic quadrilateral** where sides are produced to meet at point Z, the **secant-secant property** states: ZK × ZJ = ZL × ZM.

Total length ZJ = ZK + JK = 12 + 10 = 22 cm.

Applying the formula: 12 × 22 = ZL × 33

⇒ 264 = 33 × ZL

⇒ ZL = 264 ÷ 33 = 8 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

JK = 10 cm, KZ = 12 cm, MZ = 33 cm

JKLM is a **cyclic quadrilateral**.

**Formula Used:**

Intersecting Secant Theorem: When two secant lines intersect at an external point Z, the product of the external segment and the whole secant is equal for both lines: **ZK × ZJ = ZL × ZM**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09936af70abab110df4872ae0270c3b2cd3e53703e202a3034a322a2f80d8dbb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total length of secant ZJ = ZK + JK

⇒ ZJ = 12 + 10 = 22 cm

⇒ According to theorem, ZK × ZJ = ZL × ZM

⇒ 12 × 22 = ZL × 33

⇒ 264 = 33 × ZL

⇒ ZL = 264 ÷ 33

⇒ ZL = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cyclic Quadrilateral Properties

In a **cyclic quadrilateral**, the sum of opposite angles is 180°. Also, the exterior angle at any vertex is equal to the interior opposite angle.

Power of a Point Theorem

For an external point Z, the product of segments of any secant line is constant (ZK × ZJ = ZL × ZM = Constant), which is also equal to the square of the tangent length from that point.

Similar Triangles

When sides of a cyclic quadrilateral are produced, the triangle formed by the intersection point and the nearer vertices is **similar** to the triangle formed with the farther vertices (▵ZKL ∼ ▵ZMJ).</p
